reception: External citation is sparse and clusters around the architectures UGC targets. Work in the HammerBlade line uses the compiler — the paper on supporting dynamic task parallelism on manycore architectures builds with it, and the HammerBlade manycore paper lists it among the software the machine runs — while compiler papers such as MeshTaichi, a multi-target multi-paradigm DSL compiler for algorithmic graph processing, and a tensor processing framework for CPU-manycore heterogeneous systems give it closer readings as a point of comparison for multi-backend design. A systematic literature review of graph-processing DSLs records it among the languages of the field. The compiler lives on in the GraphIt-DSL/graphit repository.
